title: What It Actually Looks Like for a Godly Man to Lead by Kneeling First
caption:
What it actually looks like for a godly man to lead by kneeling first.

Authority and servanthood aren't opposites. They're the same move. Christ had every right in the room and used it to kneel down with a towel.

A leader who can't take correction from someone he outranks has confused position with wisdom. You can tell who actually leads by watching who eats last, not who talks first.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #leadership #servanthood
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
